column1: # Offline native Windows world/adventure map site-card rumor source catalogue.
# The native formatter reads screen+0x440 rumor pointers, type +0x24; retains wrapped std::string* at screen+0x8310.
# Includes all 26 jump-table entries, the out-of-range branch, every finite paragraph branch, and native shared text producers in both configured PE editions.
# This catalogue is extracted source data, not a test, generated runtime translation, or claim of observed game rendering.
# Every paragraph begins In {date}, and ends with one period; the producer capitalizes it, inserts an empty string between paragraphs, and wraps at 54 cells on spaces.
# Filters reject outmoded rumors, future validity, and occurrences at least two years old; local site/entity location selection precedes formatting.
# World names, race/caste RAWs, position RAW names and generated book titles are unbounded dynamic slots. Existing item-description-sources.tsv supplies virtual item naming subclasses.
